LESSON: WRITING 1.4.1 HANDWRITING: LONG WORDS AND DESCENDERS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Writing 1.4.1 Handwriting: Long Words and Descenders
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 1.4.1 Handwriting: Long Words and Descenders, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we write neatly and legibly? 2. How are the letters of the alphabet shaped?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1.  Look at a sample text with good handwriting.  Point out aspects of good handwriting in a text.

2. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication.  Copy letter patterns of the target letter- sound combinations (bl, br, ch, cl), with peers.  Copy words related to the language pattern.  Write words related to the theme in response to a picture prompt. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted writing tools and materials, alternative functional parts of the body 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1.  Look at a sample text with good handwriting.  Point out aspects of good handwriting in a text.
2. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication.  Copy letter patterns of the target letter- sound combinations (bl, br, ch, cl), with peers.  Copy words related to the language pattern.  Write words related to the theme in response to a picture prompt. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted writing tools and materials, alternative functional parts of the body 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 1.4.1 Handwriting: Long Words and Descenders together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Communication: The learner’s ability to write clearly and correctly is developed as they write words with descenders and

target letter-sound combinations bl, br, ch, and cl in clear and legible handwriting.

 Learning to learn: The learner’s ability to learn independently is enhanced as they practise writing clearly and legibly on

their own.

Link to

Values:
Respect is cultivated as the learner positively regards the effort of peers as they try to write clearly and legibly.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Learner Support Programme (Peer education and mentorship): The learner’s ability to mentor others is developed as they model

good handwriting to peers.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner uses the writing skills to write clearly and legibly in other learning areas.
